name: Exercise
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of strength both physically and spiritually, recognizing that wisdom and knowledge contribute to increasing one’s might. The believer is called to present their body as a living sacrifice, honoring God through disciplined care, as reflected in the example of diligent physical preparation. True strength is ultimately renewed and empowered by waiting on the Lord and relying on Christ, who strengthens us to endure and accomplish all things.
